raw.rationale: Lupanine is a plant quinolizidine alkaloid with weak sodium-channel-blocking activity and no known lineage-selective dependencies or PRISM evidence of cytotoxicity at 2.5 µM; most such compounds show no lineage selectivity, so probabilities are near the low base rate. Slight elevations are assigned to lineages with frequent sodium-channel or neuroendocrine/transport-related biology (CNS, lung, skin, pancreas), but all remain well below 0.05.
